key.name: snap-location
key.description: Where to place the pointer in the focused window: “center” moves it to the middle of the window, “relative” restores the position it last had relative to that window.

key.name: snap-timing
key.description: When to move the pointer relative to window animations: “before” jumps to the final position immediately, “smooth” moves it along with the animating window, “after” waits until the window has stopped moving.
